summary: Verified iter-76 frontend URL fix for Email Accounts Export CSV. Frontend now calls the correct single-/api-prefix endpoint, receives a proper CSV download with 27 columns incl. decrypted credentials, and shows a success toast. Backend regression suite (10 iter-75 tests) still passes. Double-prefix URL correctly returns 404 (backend-side untouched).
action_items: Docs/PR description: the route is /accounts not /email-accounts (the review request called it /email-accounts, which is actually a catch-all redirect to /). This is not a bug, just an authoring nit.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailAccounts.jsx handleExportAccountsCSV correctly uses api.get('/accounts/export?...') without leading /api (axios instance already has baseURL=`${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`). This matches the pattern of every other call in the file.
Consider adding a small unit/integration test in the frontend that asserts axios instance baseURL ends with '/api' exactly once, to prevent future double-prefix regressions.
